annotations.title: Create a checkout link to add credits

description: Create a hosted Dodo checkout link bound to the user's connected TranscriptLab account (no website sign-in required). Use when the user runs out of credits (insufficient_credits), asks to upgrade, or wants to buy more credits. Choose starter ($3.99/mo for 1,000 monthly credits) or credit_pack ($4.99 one-time for 1,000 non-expiring credits). Always show the returned checkout_url verbatim as a clickable link.

offer.description: starter ($3.99/mo for 1,000 monthly credits) or credit_pack ($4.99 one-time for 1,000 non-expiring credits).
